cs.t: I recently got this monitor arm by VIVO from amazon:  https://www.amazon.com/dp/B01NH0HTM5/  It is just $29 and the quality is decent and it holds my 32 inch 4K lg monitor with no problem. There is a weight limit so check your monitor weight before you purchase, but do NOT spend more than that on a monitor stand, most of them are identical.
